anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.text:
gauntlet: question
Which behavior should the report view's workspace-switch filter policy select?
A) clear all filters on every workspace switch
B) preserve all active filters across switches
C) restore each workspace's last filters
Recommendation: B - the view's workspace-change handler already retains active filters, so the resolver default at settings/resolver.ts:12 keeps current behavior for existing users and needs no per-workspace filter state that C would add.

gauntlet: question
Which filter behavior should the report view use when switching workspaces?
A) Clear all filters on every workspace switch.
B) Preserve all active filters across workspace switches.
C) Restore each workspace’s last filters.
Recommendation: B - it preserves the view’s current behavior and avoids introducing per-workspace filter storage.
